method: Shuffled warm CUDA graphs, ~50ms warmup per sample; G=1; unlocked clocks. Identical input and output addresses; fixed config per shape. No quantization input cost. FP8-only retains BF16 rounding before quantization but removes BF16 allocation, shared stores, TMA stores and associated synchronization.

api.return: FP8 qout; scales are plan.qscales; plan.out is None
api.quantization: BF16 rounding in registers retained; FP8 and scales bitwise equal to dual-output
api.c_abi: tk_mx_create_quantized selects FP8-only specialization when BF16 output pointer is null

convergence: An explicit __syncwarp before FP8-only quantization removes redundant WARPSYNC.COLLECTIVE lowering seen when the BF16-store barrier is simply deleted.
